description: A company's fiscal calendar: when its fiscal year ends, whether it runs 52/53-week years, any calendar note the record carries, and the exact start date, end date and length in days (and weeks, where the record states them) of every fiscal year and quarter held across every published record. Use it to line a company's fiscal periods up against calendar dates or against another company: NVIDIA's fiscal year ends in late January, Apple's in late September, Microsoft's on June 30.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol, case-insensitive. Examples: NVDA, brk-b, BRK.B.

name: get_fiscal_calendar
title: Fiscal calendar
